name: Saint Barthélemy

findings.summary: The Collectivité approved in principle linking St Barth to Orange's planned CELIA subsea cable, funding about EUR 10m; studies 2025, construction 2026, service 2027. An FCC application lists St. Barts as a landing.
findings.analyst_inference: Equipment vendor rule: DCD names ASN (French) as CELIA cable supplier but does not list St Barth; Communications Daily (FCC filing, partly paywalled) lists St. Barts but no supplier. Applying ASN to the St Barth branch is inference. French controller coded third, consistent with HKG treating parent-state vendors as foreign. Tier 2: approval in principle and studies; construction not confirmed. EUR value not converted.

findings.summary: Orange announced the commercial launch of its 5G network in Saint-Barthélemy from 11 August 2023, starting with Saint-Jean and Gustavia and extending progressively over following months.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null: spec sets network pole by equipment vendor, which the source does not name. Tier 5 as a commercial launch, though coverage was initially limited to two zones. No Huawei/ZTE mention found. Single opened S3 source, so low.

facilities.null_reason: one search found no data-centre or AI-campus project in Saint-Barthélemy; only a new fibre NRO node building in Saint-Jean (H2 2026) surfaced, not a data centre

silicon.null_reason: no dedicated search; no accelerator purchase or deployment surfaced in other searches

models.null_reason: one combined search on AI/Huawei/Hikvision returned only generic results; no frontier-model partnership or sovereign model found

applications.null_reason: two searches (vidéoprotection; Hikvision/AI) found no Saint-Barthélemy surveillance or e-government AI procurement

research_gaps: Confirm whether the St Barth CELIA branch reached construction/contract stage, its final value, and whether ASN supplies the branch unit.
RAN/core equipment vendors of Orange Caraïbe, Digicel and Free Caraïbe (ex-Dauphin Telecom) in Saint-Barthélemy; whether French 2019 Huawei authorisation regime has been applied to overseas sites.
Equipment vendor and operator of the Collectivité-led FTTH network (Saint-Barth Digital); the Arcep SDTAN for Saint-Barthélemy (not opened) may name the delegate.
Any municipal vidéoprotection system in Gustavia and its camera/VMS vendor.
